contract: extern C void launch_kernel(float* q, float* k, float* v, float* p, float* grad_o, float* grad_q, float* grad_k, float* grad_v, int batch, int heads, int seq, int head_dim, float scale)

arguments.name: p
arguments.description: softmax probabilities from forward [batch, heads, seq, seq]

arguments.name: grad_o
arguments.description: gradient of loss w.r.t. attention output [batch, heads, seq, head_dim]

arguments.name: grad_q
arguments.description: gradient w.r.t. query [batch, heads, seq, head_dim]

arguments.name: grad_k
arguments.description: gradient w.r.t. key [batch, heads, seq, head_dim]

arguments.name: grad_v
arguments.description: gradient w.r.t. value [batch, heads, seq, head_dim]

contract_schema.semantics:
FP32 backward pass for non-causal dense scaled dot-product attention.

Forward: S = Q @ K^T * scale, P = softmax(S, dim=-1), O = P @ V

Given upstream gradient dO:
  dV = P^T @ dO
  dP = dO @ V^T
  For each row i: dot_i = sum_j(dP[i,j] * P[i,j]), dS[i,j] = P[i,j] * (dP[i,j] - dot_i)
  dQ = dS @ K * scale
  dK = dS^T @ Q * scale

Layouts: Q/K/V/dO/dQ/dK/dV: [B,H,S,D] FP32; P: [B,H,S,S] FP32.
P is provided from forward; kernel must NOT recompute softmax.
All three gradients (dQ, dK, dV) must be computed.
